comment:
* Selects routes to connect to an origin server. Each connection requires a
 * choice of proxy server, IP address, and TLS mode. Connections may also be
 * recycled.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: proxies
variables.comment: State for negotiating the next proxy to use.

variables.name: inetSocketAddresses
variables.comment: State for negotiating the next socket address to use.

methods.name: public boolean hasNext()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if there's another route to attempt. Every address has at
   * least one route.

methods.name: public void connectFailed(Route failedRoute, IOException failure)
methods.comment:
* Clients should invoke this method when they encounter a connectivity
   * failure on a connection returned by this route selector.

methods.name: private void resetNextProxy(HttpUrl url, Proxy proxy)
methods.comment: Prepares the proxy servers to try.

methods.name: private boolean hasNextProxy()
methods.comment: Returns true if there's another proxy to try.

methods.name: private Proxy nextProxy() throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns the next proxy to try. May be PROXY.NO_PROXY but never null.

methods.name: private void resetNextInetSocketAddress(Proxy proxy) throws IOException
methods.comment: Prepares the socket addresses to attempt for the current proxy or host.

methods.name: private boolean hasNextInetSocketAddress()
methods.comment: Returns true if there's another socket address to try.

methods.name: private InetSocketAddress nextInetSocketAddress() throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns the next socket address to try.

methods.name: private boolean hasNextPostponed()
methods.comment: Returns true if there is another postponed route to try.

methods.name: private Route nextPostponed()
methods.comment: Returns the next postponed route to try.

methodNames: public void connectFailed(Route failedRoute, IOException failure)
private void resetNextProxy(HttpUrl url, Proxy proxy)
private void resetNextInetSocketAddress(Proxy proxy) throws IOException
